name: Laxmi Dental Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2004, Laxmi Dental is an integrated dental products company offering a comprehensive portfolio of Dental Products[1]
keyPoints: Leading Dental Company[1] Laxmi Dental is India’s only end-to-end integrated dental products company, operating across the full dental value chain — dental laboratory services, clear aligners, aligner materials & machines, and paediatric dental products. It is the second-largest domestic dental lab player and the largest Indian export dental laboratory
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 103% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 72.9 days to 182 days
